$comment: BRIEF.md §2: 'No individual is named or pictured on marketing surfaces. Assessment
artifacts do carry a named assessor, by design. Build the assessor field as a list
that renders one entry today and three later, everywhere it appears.'
`assessors` is empty and that is not a placeholder: the blank scorecard names
nobody because no assessment has been performed on it. When it is filled in, each
entry gets a row. Until then the form prints `blankSlots` empty rows to write in.
Either way the scorecard renders a LIST. Adding a second assessor is a data change,
not a layout change, which is the whole point of building it this way at one.
